clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 迈克尔·塞勒转向StrategyInc.拟出售12.5亿美元比特币

subtitles.en: So, Monique, there's really a lot today, Jess here. But maybe we can start with strategy.
subtitles.zh: 莫妮克，今天消息很多。我们先从策略说起吧。

subtitles.en: What is the biggest shift in their, well, strategy?
subtitles.zh: 他们策略上最大的转变是什么？

subtitles.en: Yes, so strategy, they are doing quite a pivot.
subtitles.zh: 是的，策略上他们正在大转向。

subtitles.en: The company had always been focused since it changed becoming a Bitcoin Treasury company in 2020 to buying Bitcoin and holding it.
subtitles.zh: 自2020年转型为比特币储备公司以来，该公司一直专注于购买并持有比特币。

subtitles.en: That was their main goal. But now we're seeing that they're saying that they're gonna look more into selling Bitcoin.
subtitles.zh: 那是他们的主要目标。但现在我们看到他们表示将更多地考虑出售比特币。

subtitles.en: We saw earlier this month, they made their first Bitcoin sales in years and now they're expected to do more.
subtitles.zh: 本月早些时候，他们进行了多年来的首次比特币销售，预计后续还会有更多。

subtitles.en: They're saying they could sell up to over $1 billion of Bitcoin to fund their reserves.
subtitles.zh: 他们表示可能出售超过10亿美元的比特币来充实储备。

subtitles.en: They're also gonna be looking at buying back some of their preferred shares as well as some of their common shares.
subtitles.zh: 他们还将考虑回购部分优先股和普通股。

subtitles.en: And this is largely due to the fact of those pressures that we have seen on their share price recently, as well as the pressures in the broader crypto space that have been weighing on Bitcoin.
subtitles.zh: 这主要是由于近期股价压力以及更广泛的加密市场对比特币的拖累。

subtitles.en: Strategy is a leveraged play on the cryptocurrency, so when Bitcoin performs well, strategy outperforms when Bitcoin declined strategy underperforms.
subtitles.zh: 策略是加密货币的杠杆化**，因此比特币表现好时策略表现更好，比特币下跌时策略表现更差。

subtitles.en: That's what this longer downturn we've been seeing. They've now have to pivot to not just buying and holding Bitcoin, but also being able to still make their payments
subtitles.zh: 这就是我们看到的长期低迷。他们现在不得不转变策略，不再只是买入并持有比特币，还要能支付股息和履行其他财务义务，这意味着必须卖出比特币。

subtitles.en: on their dividends and meet some of their other financial obligations, which means having to sell Bitcoin.
subtitles.zh: 支付股息和履行其他财务义务，这意味着必须卖出比特币。

subtitles.en: Strategies and them also fell below parity. Why is that such an important turning point?
subtitles.zh: 策略及其股价也跌破了面值。为什么这是一个如此重要的转折点？

subtitles.en: So this is something very important for strategy. It's main selling feature has been that it can get a premium to its Bitcoin holdings.
subtitles.zh: 这对策略来说非常重要。其主要卖点一直是能够获得相对于其比特币持仓的溢价。
